followup_explanation:
This is a creative/pop-culture recommendation task with no harmful or sensitive content involved, so the deciding factor is general capability rather than either model's specialized tolerance for distasteful material.

Petrel-235B has clearly stronger scores across the board on the relevant dimensions: higher Arena-Hard (90.6 vs 81.4), higher Creative Generation (84.7 vs 78.8), and better instruction-following on IFEval (89.8 vs 85.6). The user's request includes an implicit demand for thoughtful, well-reasoned output ("actually think about it this time"), which favors the model with stronger reasoning and creative-generation capability.

Avocet's main distinguishing feature — flat preference response to harm-adjacent content — offers no advantage here since the query is entirely benign. So Petrel is the better fit on raw capability.
